audit_items.proof_trace: In `withdrawRaisedCapital()`, `totalCapitalWithdrawn` is set to `_totalCapitalRaised` (the gross amount including fees, line 247). In `cancel()`, `capitalToReturn = totalCapitalWithdrawn = _totalCapitalRaised`, and `safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), capitalToReturn)` recovers the full gross amount. Since `_totalCapitalRaised = netCapital + legionFee + referrerFee`, the transfer covers exactly the property assertion: `raisedCapital + legionFee + referrerFee`.
